cues: Cellular endosperm puts a wall after every division right from the start, as in Datura and Petunia.
Helobial endosperm is in between: the first division makes two unequal chambers, and then it goes free nuclear.
And when the seed coat folds irregularly into the endosperm, as in betel nut and nutmeg, it is called ruminate.
